description: Fully developed rough-wall closed channel (walls at z = 0 and z = 2 m, half height H = 1 m), k-omega (T 10 2) with wall functions (B 10 1), periodic in x, driven by a body force g_x = u*^2/H (u* = 0.2 m/s, ks = 0.01 m, nu = 1e-6). After 400 s (steady) the velocity in the lower 15 % must follow the rough log law u = (u*/kappa) ln(30 z/ks).
